name: B10-0095/2026 (S&D) – Brutal repression against protesters in Iran
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the brutal repression against protesters in Iran
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly condemns Iran's violent crackdown on protesters, which it says has killed thousands and led to over 10,000 arrests. It calls on the European Union to impose more sanctions on Iranian officials and to label the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps a terrorist organisation. It also asks Iran to release all prisoners held for protesting, and urges the European Union to support Iranian civil society and help people who flee the country.

- The European Union is asked to widen sanctions and label Iran's Revolutionary Guard a terrorist group.
- Iran is asked to free everyone jailed for protesting and stop blocking the internet.
- The European Union should help Iranian activists, journalists and minorities with visas and funding.
